title: The 2-fibre product of a representable morphism with a space-representable category is representable by an algebraic space

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement

standard_prerequisites.name: Setoid-to-presheaf correspondence
standard_prerequisites.use: Identify the 2-fibre product with S_F for a presheaf F and transfer the 1-morphism to a map F -> G.

standard_prerequisites.name: Representability transfer for setoid presheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers representability by algebraic spaces from the 1-morphism to the map F -> G.

standard_prerequisites.name: Bootstrap over an algebraic space
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes F is an algebraic space.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base-change stability
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-base-change-representable-by-spaces (same chapter, NOT carded, declared external)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the projection to Z representable by algebraic spaces.

core_obligations: Observe the 2-fibre product is fibred in setoids over the big site, hence equivalent to S_F for a presheaf F.
Let G be the algebraic space representing Z; the projection to Z corresponds to a map F -> G of presheaves.
Show F -> G is representable by algebraic spaces: the projection is representable (base-change stability) and the correspondence preserves representability.
Apply the bootstrap-over-a-space lemma to conclude F is an algebraic space.
proof_roadmap: Setoid identification; sheaf correspondence; representability transfer; bootstrap finish.
difficulty_reason: A four-step reduction chain from stacks in groupoids to presheaves with a bootstrap finish; each step is a named input applied exactly.
